# CBAM Embedded Emissions: Not Calculated, Country of Production Missing

I can't calculate the embedded emissions yet because the country of production is missing.

## Input check

| Required input | Provided | Status |
|---|---|---|
| (a) CN code in table | 7207 11 90 (semi-finished products of iron or non-alloy steel) | ✅ Valid |
| (b) Country of production | "Partner plant," origin to be confirmed by the mill's certificate (not attached) | ❌ **Missing** |
| (c) Quantity (tonnes) | 4,200 t | ✅ Valid |

## Why this blocks the calculation

Default SEE values depend on both the CN code and the country. For CN 7207 11 90 the table lists three different values:

| Country | Default SEE (tCO2e/t) |
|---|---|
| Türkiye | 3.087 |
| China | 3.314 |
| India | 4.32 |

The difference between these factors is large, so choosing or averaging one would produce an unreliable figure. The ruleset also says not to estimate when an input is missing.

## What's needed to proceed

Please send the **mill's certificate of origin** (or other confirmation of the country of production). Once I have it, the calculation is:

**Embedded emissions = SEE (CN 7207 11 90, confirmed country) × 4,200 t**, rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.

Note: if the confirmed country is not Türkiye, China or India, this table has no default value for it, and a calculation still won't be possible under this ruleset.
